title: Crouching Young Soldier by Bushes, 1940s WWII Military Snapshot Photo
description: A World War II-era snapshot showing a clean-shaven young serviceman crouching outdoors on a grassy embankment in front of dense evergreen foliage. He is dressed in standard light military service khakis with the sleeves rolled up, sporting a visible unit shoulder insignia patch and a wristwatch. The portrait captures a casual, off-duty moment typical of soldiers stationed at training camps or bases across the United States during the 1940s.
